trending.name: lvgl
trending.author: kisvegabor
trending.sentence: Full-featured Graphics Library for Embedded Systems
trending.paragraph: Powerful and easy-to-use embedded GUI with many widgets, advanced visual effects (opacity, antialiasing, animations) and low memory requirements (16K RAM, 64K Flash).

trending.name: FastLED
trending.author: Daniel Garcia
trending.sentence: Multi-platform library for controlling dozens of different types of LEDs along with optimized math, effect, and noise functions.
trending.paragraph: FastLED is a fast, efficient, easy-to-use Arduino library for programming addressable LED strips and pixels such as WS2810, WS2811, LPD8806, Neopixel and more. FastLED also provides high-level math functions that can be used for generative art and graphics.

trending.name: WiFiManager
trending.author: tzapu
trending.sentence: WiFi Configuration manager with web configuration portal for Espressif ESPx boards, by tzapu
trending.paragraph: Library for configuring ESP8266/ESP32 modules WiFi credentials and custom parameters at runtime with captive portal.

trending.name: ArduinoJson
trending.author: Benoit Blanchon <blog.benoitblanchon.fr>
trending.sentence: A simple and efficient JSON library for embedded C++.
trending.paragraph: ⭐ 7124 stars on GitHub! Supports serialization, deserialization, MessagePack, streams, filtering, and more. Fully tested and documented.

trending.name: Blinker
trending.author: i3water
trending.sentence: Build a easy way for your IoT project.
trending.paragraph: Blinker library for embedded hardware. Support Arduino, ESP8266, ESP32, WiFi, BLE, MQTT.

trending.name: IRremote
trending.author: shirriff, z3t0, ArminJo
trending.sentence: Send and receive infrared signals with multiple protocols
trending.paragraph: Currently included protocols: Denon / Sharp, JVC, LG,  NEC / Onkyo / Apple, Panasonic / Kaseikyo, RC5, RC6, Samsung, Sony, (Pronto), BangOlufsen, BoseWave, Lego, Whynter, FAST, MagiQuest, Velux, Universal Pulse Distance and Pulse Width.

trending.name: TFT_eSPI
trending.author: Bodmer
trending.sentence: TFT graphics library for Arduino processors with performance optimisation for RP2040, STM32, ESP8266 and ESP32
trending.paragraph: Supports TFT displays using drivers (ILI9341 etc.) that operate with hardware SPI or 8/16-bit parallel.

trending.name: PubSubClient
trending.author: Nick O'Leary <nick.oleary@gmail.com>
trending.sentence: A client library for MQTT messaging.
trending.paragraph: MQTT is a lightweight messaging protocol ideal for small devices. This library allows you to send and receive MQTT messages. It supports the latest MQTT 3.1.1 protocol and can be configured to use the older MQTT 3.1 if needed. It supports all Arduino Ethernet Client compatible hardware, including the Intel Galileo/Edison, ESP8266 and TI CC3000.

trending.name: Blynk
trending.author: Blynk
trending.sentence: Build a smartphone app for your project in minutes!
trending.paragraph: It supports  WiFi, Ethernet, Cellular connectivity. Works with over 400 boards like ESP8266, ESP32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, Particle, etc.

trending.name: IRremoteESP8266

trending.maintainer: David Conran, Mark Szabo, Sebastien Warin, Roi Dayan, Massimiliano Pinto, Christian Nilsson
trending.sentence: Send and receive infrared signals with multiple protocols (ESP8266/ESP32)
trending.paragraph: This library enables you to send and receive infra-red signals on an ESP8266 or an ESP32.

trending.name: Adafruit NeoPixel
trending.author: Adafruit
trending.sentence: Arduino library for controlling single-wire-based LED pixels and strip.
trending.paragraph: Arduino library for controlling single-wire-based LED pixels and strip.

trending.name: MFRC522
trending.author: GithubCommunity
trending.sentence: Arduino RFID Library for MFRC522 (SPI)
trending.paragraph: Read/Write a RFID Card or Tag using the ISO/IEC 14443A/MIFARE interface.

trending.name: Simple FOC
trending.author: Simplefoc <info@simplefoc.com>
trending.sentence: A library demistifying FOC for BLDC motors
trending.paragraph: Simple library intended for hobby comunity to run the BLDC and Stepper motor using FOC algorithm. It is intended to support as many BLDC/Stepper motor+sensor+driver combinations as possible and in the same time maintain simplicity of usage. Library supports Arudino devices such as Arduino UNO, MEGA, NANO and similar, stm32 boards such as Nucleo and Bluepill, ESP32 and Teensy boards.

trending.name: Adafruit GFX Library
trending.author: Adafruit
trending.sentence: Adafruit GFX graphics core library, this is the 'core' class that all our other graphics libraries derive from.
trending.paragraph: Install this library in addition to the display library for your hardware.

trending.name: PJON
trending.author: Giovanni Blu Mitolo <gioscarab@gmail.com>
trending.sentence: PJON is an open-source, multi-master, multi-media bus network protocol
trending.paragraph: It is a valid alternative to i2c, 1-Wire, CAN and other protocols

trending.name: Watchy

trending.name: RadioLib
trending.author: Jan Gromes <gromes.jan@gmail.com>
trending.sentence: Universal wireless communication library
trending.paragraph: User-friendly library for sub-GHz radio modules (SX1278, RF69, CC1101, SX1268, LR1110, LR2021 and many others), as well as ham radio digital modes (RTTY, SSTV, AX.25 etc.) and other protocols (Pagers, LoRaWAN, ADS-B).

trending.name: RF24

trending.paragraph: Core library for nRF24L01(+) communication. Simple to use for beginners, but offers advanced configuration options. Many examples are included to demonstrate various modes of communication.

trending.name: ESP8266Audio

trending.sentence: Audio file and I2S sound playing routines for ESP8266, ESP32, and Raspberry Pi Pico RP2040
trending.paragraph: Decode compressed MP3, AAC, FLAC, Screamtracker MOD, MIDI, RTTL, TI Talkie, and WAV and play on an I2S DAC or a software-driven delta-sigma DAC and 1-transistor amplifier.

hidden_gems.name: bthome-cpp
hidden_gems.author: mvoss96
hidden_gems.sentence: Dependency-free C++17 BTHome v2 payload builder and parser.
hidden_gems.paragraph: Builds and parses BTHome v2 service-data bytes (no BLE stack). No heap, no exceptions, no RTTI. Supports AES-CCM encryption and decryption with pluggable crypto backends (mbedtls and PSA adapters included), including replay protection on the receiving side. Think in sensor values; the library handles object IDs, scaling, endianness and canonical ordering. Pair with any BLE stack.

Non-blocking fashion-tech effects (Sequin, Catwalk, Loom, Silk, Aurora, Heartbeat, Firefly, Ember, Morse messenger), automatic current limiting for battery safety, a live status pixel, async RMT engine, and optional dual-core AutoPilot mode. Onboard pixel on GPIO 3 for the CMoz ESP32-S3 Mini; any valid pin on other boards.

hidden_gems.name: dv_iir_filter8

hidden_gems.name: NessoLink
hidden_gems.author: Ugur Sayar <ugursayar@gmail.com>
hidden_gems.sentence: Versioned binary control-link protocol for the Nesso N1 robot controller.
hidden_gems.paragraph: RemoteFrame v1/v2 codec (motors, up to two aux sticks, a 16-button bitfield, CRC-8 checked) plus WiFi UDP, TCP, BLE and LoRa (RadioLib) transports. The codec is header-only and dependency-free, so it runs on both the transmitter and the robot receiver on any board; each transport is compile-guarded, so codec-only users pull in no heavy dependencies.

hidden_gems.name: AzureIoT
hidden_gems.author: Ts. Dr. Mohd Husaini bin Mohd Fauzi <mhusaini@syncmind.my>
hidden_gems.maintainer: Ts. Dr. Mohd Husaini bin Mohd Fauzi <mhusaini@syncmind.my>
hidden_gems.sentence: Connects an Arduino Uno WiFi Rev2 or an ESP32 board to Azure IoT Central: WiFi, on-device DPS provisioning, MQTT telemetry, and cloud-to-device control.
hidden_gems.paragraph: Replaces firedog1024/arduino-uno-wifi-iotc + the archived Azure/dps-keygen tool. No PC-side tooling required -- the board provisions itself via Azure's Device Provisioning Service at boot. Includes writable-property support for controlling actuators (LEDs, buzzers) from the IoT Central dashboard, and reading another device's telemetry via the IoT Central REST API. See the 22 included examples, ordered easiest to hardest.

hidden_gems.name: TameModbus

See examples/ for a guided walkthrough.
